title: Clause Commentary — The Year Share of a Guarantee Payment, Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# The Year Share of a Guarantee Payment

Commentary on the clause prorating a shortfall payment under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions where the guarantee stood behind the old plant, or behind the term, for part of the year only. A year is 12 months.

## Clause

Where a replacement or retrofit project at the building closed inside the twelve months ending on the day of the payment and the tier resets its baseline on retrofit, the year share is the whole months of those twelve that ran before the project closed, of twelve, because the guarantee stands behind the old plant only for the part of the year it ran. Where no such project closed inside those twelve months and the subscription's current term began inside them, the year share is the whole months since the term began, of twelve. In every other case the year share is the whole year.

## Commentary

**First limb.** Both parts must hold: a project at the building, recorded under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects, closed no more than twelve whole months before the day of the payment, and the tier resets its baseline on retrofit. The share is then 12 less the whole months since the project closed, over 12: a project that closed 5 whole months ago gives 7 of 12, that is 58.33 percent.

**Second limb.** No such project closed inside those twelve months — the most recent close is more than twelve whole months old — and the term start date standing on the subscription falls inside them, so the term has run fewer than 12 whole months. The share is the whole months since the term began, over 12: a term that has run 9 whole months gives 75 percent.

**Third limb.** The whole year, 100 percent: a term of 12 whole months or more with no recent project close, or a project closed inside the twelve months at a tier that does not reset its baseline on retrofit.

## Table

| Whole months since a project at the building closed | Tier resets its baseline on retrofit | Whole months the current term has run | Year share |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12 or fewer | yes | any | 12 less those months, of 12 |
| more than 12 | any | fewer than 12 | those months, of 12 |
| more than 12 | any | 12 or more | 100 percent |
| 12 or fewer | no | 12 or more | 100 percent |
